o.norm: Output array is not large enough to accommodate decoded data.

i.norm: Verifies that decodeHex throws when the output offset far exceeds the output array length, leaving no room to write the decoded bytes. A 6-char hex input decodes to 3 bytes, but with outOffset=1589 the required range [1589, 1592) lies entirely outside the 7-element output array, so the method must reject the call with "Output array is not large enough to accommodate decoded data."
6 null hex characters — would decode to 3 bytes if the output had room
output array of only 7 bytes; at offset 1589 there is no space for the 3 decoded bytes
Output array is not large enough to accommodate decoded data.
